description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionStatusMessageMapper class, which maps external messages related to connectivity status into Ditto protocol commands for updating features on Thing entities. It extracts headers such as 'creation-time' and 'ttd,' constructs feature modifications, and handles configuration for Thing IDs and feature IDs.

classes.name: ConnectionStatusMessageMapper
classes.description: A mapper that converts incoming external messages containing connection status information into Ditto feature modification commands, updating the 'ConnectionStatus' feature with properties such as status and timestamps.

methods.name: doConfigure
methods.description: Configures the mapper with the provided configuration, mainly setting the thingId and featureId based on the mapping configuration.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable Ditto commands, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: doMap
methods.description: Performs the core mapping logic, extracting headers, resolving placeholders, and creating feature modification adaptables based on 'creation-time' and 'ttd' headers.

methods.name: getModifyFeaturePropertyAdaptable
methods.description: Creates an Adaptable for updating the 'readyUntil' property of the connection status feature.

methods.name: getModifyFeatureAdaptable
methods.description: Creates an Adaptable for modifying the entire 'ConnectionStatus' feature, including 'readySince' and 'readyUntil' properties.

methods.name: applyPlaceholderReplacement
methods.description: Applies placeholder resolution to a template string using the provided expression resolver.

methods.name: getExpressionResolver
methods.description: Constructs an ExpressionResolver based on message headers.

methods.name: getMappingFailedException
methods.description: Builds an exception indicating mapping failure with details.

methods.name: extractLongHeader
methods.description: Extracts and parses a header value as a long, with error handling.
